evidence.title: GitHub - tremorlabs/tremor-npm: React components to build charts and dashboards
Tremor NPM • The React UI kit to build dashboards and charts

name: Tremor NPM
summary: Open-source React and Tailwind component library of 20+ components for charts and dashboards.
description: Components for data-rich interfaces: area, bar, line, scatter, donut, funnel and spark charts, bar lists, data bars, tracker and progress circle, plus UI pieces such as card, table, tabs, select, switch, date range picker, dialog, accordion and text/number inputs. Built on Tailwind CSS and Recharts; needs React 18.2+, Tailwind 3.4+ and Headless UI. Open source by Tremor Labs (now joining Vercel).
contains: 20+ open-source components for charts and dashboards
visualizations: area, bar, line, scatter, donut, funnel and spark charts, bar list, tracker
UI: accordion, badge, button, callout, card, date picker, dialog, list, select, switch, table, tabs, inputs
built on Tailwind CSS and Recharts; React 18.2+, Tailwind 3.4+ and Headless UI
